name: Incentive Premium 6
definition: Cash premium made available if the securities holder consents or participates to an event.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Cash premium paid per security, per vote or per attendee.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies which voting related criteria gives rights to an incentive premium.

PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date/time for the payment of the premium.
